component.name: InboxCraft
component.summary: Read your mail on your own computer

description.p: InboxCraft is an open-source mail and calendar program for IMAP, SMTP and CalDAV. It runs on your own computer and keeps a local copy of your mail.

This is a development build. It shows the mail list; the reader, adding an account and sending come later. Start it with the sample mailbox to look around without an account: nothing connects anywhere.
